integrity: The authorship and provenance of the underlying RK-RK algorithm are attributed to the cited literature; this is a mathematical analysis of a correlated-row variant, not a claim of independent third-party certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply to nonzero real diagonal factors, zero initial iterates, fixed in-time independent pair coupling, and original factor-row norm-squared marginals; they do not imply an improvement for arbitrary nonorthogonal systems or runtime.
title: Optimal paired-row sampling and an exact synchronization window in factorized Kaczmarz
